name: Cloud and virtualized evidence
steps: Snapshot the VM volume and memory (if available) via provider API; note snapshot IDs and times.
Capture IAM access logs, key rotations, login events (CloudTrail, Azure AD sign-ins, GCP audit).
Preserve the instance metadata: instance ID, AMI/image, launch time, attached IAM role.
Export from managed services with official export functions; record the export job ID and completion time.
Do not assume the provider's retention covers your needs — snapshot early.
tools: AWS CLI, az CLI, gcloud, provider console exports
notes: Cloud evidence often lives in immutable logs with fixed retention — collect before expiry.
